2607.23670.title: Plans Work in Mysterious Ways: Evaluating a Plan Mode for Spreadsheet Agents
2607.23670.paper_summary: Plan Modes have become standard features in agentic programming tools, allowing users to gain transparency and control by working with the agent to develop a plan before task execution. However, it remains unclear whether the benefits of this feature translate to end-user programming environments such as spreadsheets. Since spreadsheet programmers tend to work iteratively and care less about technical correctness, upfront planning may not fit into their workflows as easily. In this paper, we build a prototype of a Plan Mode for spreadsheet programming and evaluate it against a non-planning baseline through a within-subjects user study (N=24). We found that despite similar task outcomes with both tools, using Plan Mode led to a reduction in refinement and a better perception of the tool across dimensions of creativity support and human-machine collaboration. We discuss the implications of these results for the future design of Plan Modes, and for the broader role of human-AI planning in end-user programming.
2607.23670.paper_summary_zh: 計畫模式已成為代理程式設計工具中的標準功能，使用者可以透過與代理合作，在任務執行前制定計畫，以獲得透明度和控制權。<lb/>然而，目前尚不清楚這一功能的好處是否能轉化為像電子表格這樣的最終使用者程式設計環境。<lb/>由於電子表格程式設計師往往以迭代方式工作，並且對技術正確性不太在意，因此事先計畫可能不會輕易融入他們的工作流程。<lb/>在本文中，我們為電子表格程式設計建立了一個計畫模式的原型，並通過一項內部受試者的使用者研究（N=24）將其與非計畫基準進行評估。<lb/>我們發現，儘管兩種工具的任務結果相似，但使用計畫模式導致了精煉的減少，並在創造力支持和人機協作的各個維度上對工具的感知更佳。<lb/>我們討論了這些結果對未來計畫模式設計的啟示，以及對人類與人工智慧在最終使用者程式設計中更廣泛角色的影響。
